development: All v1 clips may be used as train/dev, never advertised as independent v2 test. Existing TUM walking_static is a known regression/development sequence.
new_seated_domain_test: TUM freiburg3_sitting_static first 8 seconds, no overlap with walking_static development source
labels: URFD official frame state 0 is falling, 1 is lying/background, -1 is unknown for five-class evaluation but negative for binary falling. Additional action/state intervals are provisional visual annotations, no human adjudication.
selection: Train only on train. Checkpoints selected on dev five-action macro F1. Transition thresholds chosen on train/dev only. Freeze model+config hash before any v2 test predictions. Do not tune after test.
metrics: five-class per-class precision recall F1 and coverage including unknown
fall event detection overlap and delay; no post-fall-only credit
seated-to-standing_up false-positive fraction and unknown fraction
independence_limit: Source-video disjoint, not established subject/room disjoint. HADE repeated actor remains. Public staged falls are not clinical data.
